parameters.name: edge_depth
parameters.comment: Height of the hex side wall, back to face edge

parameters.name: facet_rise
parameters.comment: How far the highest facet peak rises above the edge

parameters.name: skin_axial
parameters.comment: Face skin thickness, measured straight back (z)

parameters.name: land_width
parameters.comment: Width of the U-shaped tape land on the back

parameters.name: roof_wall
parameters.comment: Roof plate width per layer (45° roof); the space above it is sealed hollow

parameters.name: mark
parameters.comment: 1 cuts the RAHE/RIFT mark into the land, 0 leaves it plain
